text:
mike_fin: Heads up — partner Resello reported a mismatch between their AWS Marketplace settlement and our reseller ledger. Their usage shows ~21 extra instance-hours for Apr 1–7. Can someone look?

lisa_billing: thanks. do we have the partner invoice id and the AWS settlement file they sent?

mike_fin: invoice RES-2026-04-07, they uploaded a CSV to the S3 link in the partner portal. quick snippet they pasted: 
```
product,usage_start,usage_end,units,region
redwood-inference.standard,2026-04-01,2026-04-07,21,us-east-1
```
They say our internal ledger shows 0 extra units.

joel_partners: tagging in case it's on our side — we pushed the marketplace settlement to GL code 4302 last week. No manual adjustments were made.

lisa_billing: ok — two possibilities: (1) Marketplace reported commitment proration differently so partner billed extra, (2) our ingestion job dropped those rows during the Apr 3 deploy.

anya_ops: FYI billing-bot just posted a deploy event at Apr 3 03:12 UTC. Might be related.

billing-bot: deploy: finance-ingest v2.4.1 rolled out by devops at 2026-04-03T03:12:04Z.

mike_fin: can someone pull the raw AWS marketplace report (the usage CSV) and the ledger import file for the same day range and diff them? I can ask Resello for the S3 object if needed.

lisa_billing: I'm pulling both now. also please confirm whether we applied the reseller discount matrix for Resello for those SKUs — sometimes that produces negative line-item adjustments that look like "missing usage".

joel_partners: discount matrix applied. their commit band is 25–50k units monthly. this is only 21 units so shouldn't change billing.

anya_ops: got the two files from GCS/S3. quick diff shows the marketplace report contains the extra 21 units on 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC, but the ingestion CSV (what our ledger imported) doesn't have that row. looks like filtering kicked it out.

lisa_billing: did the ingestion pipeline filter rows with empty customer_id? sometimes partner-provided rows are missing our mapping key. paste of the filtered row: 
```
product,usage_start,usage_end,units,region,customer_id
redwood-inference.standard,2026-04-02T18:00:00Z,2026-04-02T18:59:59Z,21,us-east-1,
```
(empty customer_id)

mike_fin: ahhh. partner says they included one-off usage tied to 'reseller-unassigned' — they expected us to reconcile it to Resello account. we usually map reseller-unassigned -> reseller default account, but pipeline change in v2.4.1 tightened validation and dropped blank customer_id rows.

raj_ops: if pipeline dropped rows, that's on us — we should credit Resello for the 21 units. what's the unit price?

lisa_billing: unit price for that SKU in April = $295 per instance-hour. 21 * 295 = $6195. Need approval to issue a $6,195 credit note to the partner (reduce reseller payable).

joel_partners: I support issuing the credit. partner is already asking for an explanation and will delay their downstream payout if not resolved.

mike_fin: proposed steps: (1) issue credit note for $6,195, (2) backfill ledger import for Apr 2 so our accounting matches AWS settlement, (3) patch ingest to not drop blank customer_id for reseller mappings or add a fallback mapping, (4) log postmortem and notify partner.

raj_ops: approve step (1) and (2) now. please add the credit to this ticket and route to payment ops. I want a short RCA before EOD.

lisa_billing: will prepare credit note draft and GL entries. Suggested GL: debit 4302 (Reseller payables) credit 4010 (cost of goods sold correction). tagging @anya_ops to run the backfill import.

anya_ops: running backfill now. ETA ~20m. I'll post S3 object id when done.

billing-bot: finance-ticket created: FIN-3429 "Resello: missing 21 units Apr 2 — credit & backfill". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3429

mike_fin: thanks everyone. lisa — once you have the credit note PDF, can you attach it in FIN-3429 and notify the partner? put "pending payment" until treasury processes.

lisa_billing: will do. attaching draft (internal) now and cc'ing @joel_partners for sign-off before sending.

joel_partners: approved, send to partner and mark invoice RES-2026-04-07 as reconciled after they confirm.

anya_ops: backfill complete. ledger import file id: s3://redwood-billing/backfills/2026-04-02-resello-backfill.csv

mike_fin: closing loop — Resello acknowledged receipt and will apply the credit on their side after we send the credit note. thanks team. :tada: 

lisa_billing: RCA summary (FIN-3429): ingestion v2.4.1 introduced strict validation that dropped blank customer_id rows. Impact: one reseller-associated row (21 units) dropped causing mismatch. Remediation: issued $6,195 credit, backfilled ledger, adjusted ingest validation to fallback to reseller default mapping, added unit test + deploy guard.

raj_ops: good. make sure controller signs off on the GL entries before month-end close.

mike_fin: noted. leaving thread open until entries are posted.
